Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).name: Denki Kaminari (Provisional License)
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with most of his class and now holds a provisional license. Sharpshooting Gear on his costume finally lets him aim. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Ranged attacker at last: he tags a target with a pointer and his discharge follows it there; the old area burst and its overload limit remain.
Under Pressure: Panics, jokes, then aims.
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Now that he can aim, he cannot hide behind being the funny one. Motivation: Live up to the license and prove the gear makes him dependable. Concealment: The summer's attack and Kamino scared him more than he shows; a pointer that misses leaves him back where he started. Leverage: Dorm friends; proving the gear works. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, closer after months in the same dorm and still quick with a jab; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Mina Ashido, his everyday crew; Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki, and still calls him Dunce Face. Canon voice & behavior: Shows off the pointer launcher to anyone who will look; still yells for allies to clear before he fires, out of habit. Thread: Whether aimed lightning makes him the hero he keeps joking about being.
QUIRK: Electrification. Sharpshooting Gear pointers give his discharge a path to a chosen target; without one it still spreads in every direction, and overload still short-circuits his brain.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed and aiming.
personality: Class clown: Still the dorm's loudest joker, now with a license to brag about.
Big-hearted: Checks on friends after the summer, hiding the worry behind banter.
Growing focus: Practices aiming until he can hit a pointer without thinking.
Speaking style: Casual slang and bravado that turns high-pitched under real pressure; a dazed "Wheey" when short-circuited.
abilities: Sharpshooting Gear: A wrist launcher fires pointers that stick to a target and guide his discharge to it; pointers run out, and a miss means no guided shot.
Area discharge: The old unaimed burst remains for when he is surrounded; allies must still clear out or be insulated.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads, leaving him dazed and defenseless until it wears off.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act in an emergency as a licensed hero; he is still a student and answers to the pros on scene.
Fighting style: Tags targets with pointers from range, then sends his current along the link while allies stay clear; saves the area blast for when he is surrounded.
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with tousled, layered blond hair crossed by a single black lightning-bolt streak through his bangs, bright golden eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Easygoing, cocky grin and a playful look in his eyes.
